events.title: Demo 0.3 — The Red Door
events.summary: This is a big demo update! FEEDSTOCK used to be a quota game: fly into a house, grab some stuff, hand it in, move on. Now something goes wrong with every house. Little things at first. Then not-so-little things. And then you find the Red Door:3🚪 The Red DoorSomewhere in the house there's a door that has no business being there.
